name: agentic-workflow-review
description: Review and improve agentic workflows to optimize performance, enhance reliability, improve maintainability, and ensure alignment with best practices.

inputs.name: workflow_design
inputs.description: Complete workflow design including tasks, agents, handoffs, and dependencies
inputs.format: Workflow diagram, task definitions, agent specifications

inputs.name: performance_data
inputs.description: Historical performance metrics (latency, throughput, error rates, resource usage)

inputs.name: incident_reports
inputs.description: Documentation of past failures, outages, and issues

inputs.name: business_requirements
inputs.description: Current and future business needs (SLAs, scale, features)
inputs.format: Requirements document with SLAs, growth projections

inputs.name: observability_data
inputs.description: Logs, metrics, traces from production or staging
inputs.format: Log files, metric dashboards, trace data

outputs.name: review_report
outputs.description: Comprehensive assessment of workflow quality with findings and recommendations
outputs.format: Document with executive summary, detailed findings, prioritized recommendations

outputs.name: optimization_recommendations
outputs.description: Specific, actionable recommendations for performance improvements
outputs.format: List of recommendations with expected impact and implementation effort

outputs.name: reliability_improvements
outputs.format: List of improvements with failure modes addressed

outputs.name: maintainability_enhancements
outputs.description: Recommendations for improving code quality, documentation, and modularity
outputs.format: List of enhancements with maintainability benefits

outputs.name: improvement_plan
outputs.format: Project plan with tasks, timelines, owners, dependencies

outputs.name: best_practices_checklist
outputs.description: Checklist of best practices with current compliance status
outputs.format: Checklist with pass/fail status for each best practice
